analysis_universe.ambiguous_source_day_policy: A row whose provenance maps to more than one distinct source capture day is excluded from all Stage22 roles and counted.
analysis_universe.corpus: The exact processed IDS2018 corpus underlying the established 300,928-row flagship experiment.
analysis_universe.provenance_requirement: Before model fitting, Stage22 must deterministically recover the original source capture day/file provenance for the flagship corpus.
analysis_universe.unmapped_row_policy: Any corpus row that cannot be deterministically accounted for by the frozen Stage22 provenance-recovery procedure causes a hard stop before model fitting. No fuzzy/post-hoc assignment is permitted.

duplicate_leakage_protocol.cross_role_policy: If an exact feature fingerprint appears in more than one chronological role, retain occurrences only in the earliest role and exclude occurrences from every later role.
duplicate_leakage_protocol.fingerprint_feature_space: The exact frozen Stage15/Stage16 70-predictor input vector after inherited deterministic numeric coercion and before model-specific scaling.
duplicate_leakage_protocol.within_role_duplicates: Retain but count and report them; they do not constitute cross-role leakage.

evaluation_metrics.interpretation: Stage22 results are descriptive internal temporal re-evaluation evidence.
evaluation_metrics.undefined_metric_policy: Return/report undefined or NaN transparently. Do not smooth denominators to manufacture a value.

execution_order: STAGE22-0: freeze and push this protocol.
STAGE22-1: recover/inventory exact source-day provenance without model fitting.
Freeze deterministic provenance mapping and duplicate sanitization artifacts.
Train both mandatory inherited model families from scratch using Stage22 development only.
Select each model's balanced/security thresholds using Stage22 validation only.
Freeze/push partition, preprocessing, model, threshold, code, and execution hashes.
Authorize exactly one final outcome evaluation opening.
Evaluate both mandatory models at all frozen operating points and report pooled plus per-day metrics.
Close Stage22 with no post-final tuning.

final_test_governance.final_labels_must_remain_unread_until: A later Stage22 pre-final-test lock has frozen and pushed partition hashes, exclusion hashes, preprocessing hashes, trained-model hashes, validation-selected thresholds, evaluation code hashes, and execution authorization.
final_test_governance.final_test_definition: The latest two chronologically ordered usable capture days.
forbidden_after_final_outcome_opening: feature exclusion based on final performance
model retraining motivated by final scores

frozen_feature_policy.feature_identity_source: Stage15 frozen feature configuration and Stage16 inherited classical benchmark locks.

hard_prohibitions: No Stage22 data read during STAGE22-0.
No Stage22 source-day inspection during STAGE22-0.
No Stage22 partition construction during STAGE22-0.
No model forward pass during STAGE22-0.
No new architecture search in Stage22.
No new hyperparameter search in Stage22.
No new feature selection in Stage22.
No final-test-driven correction of the frozen protocol.

classical.configuration_policy: Component model/hyperparameter identities are inherited exactly from the Stage16 locks hashed by this protocol.
classical.ensemble_rule: Arithmetic mean of component attack probabilities, exactly as frozen in Stage16.

mandatory_model_families.comparison_policy: Both mandatory families are evaluated and reported. Stage22 does not select a winner for replacement of the other family.

transformer.configuration_policy: Architecture/training/checkpoint rules are inherited exactly from the Stage15 locks hashed by this protocol.
transformer.ensemble_rule: Arithmetic mean of the five frozen-recipe seed probabilities.

partition_protocol.development_role: All chronologically ordered usable capture days except the latest three.
partition_protocol.final_test_role: Exactly the latest two usable capture days, pooled as one Stage22 final test and also reported separately by day.
partition_protocol.group_definition: All source files belonging to the same calendar capture day form one indivisible group and must receive the same role.
partition_protocol.insufficient_day_policy: Hard stop. Do not invent a replacement split.
partition_protocol.ordering: Sort all deterministically recovered usable capture days in strict ascending chronological order.
partition_protocol.session_isolation_interpretation: Capture-day grouping is intentionally coarser than an individual flow/session. Therefore no within-day session can be divided across development, validation, and final-test roles. Stage22 does not invent unavailable five-tuple session identifiers.
partition_protocol.single_class_partition_policy: Report the limitation and undefined metrics transparently. Do not alter chronological roles.
partition_protocol.validation_role: Exactly the third-from-last usable capture day.

preprocessing_policy.fit_scope: Any learned preprocessing statistic must be fit using Stage22 development data only.
preprocessing_policy.rule: Use the corresponding inherited Stage15/Stage16 model-specific preprocessing recipe.

claim_boundary: Stage22 may support a stronger internal validation claim about temporal/capture isolation.
Stage22 must not be described as external validation.
Stage22 must not be described as an untouched independent confirmation because model-family choices originate from earlier IDS2018 analyses.
Any comparison against historical Stage15/Stage16 results is descriptive because the evaluation partition changes.
scientific_scope.primary_methodological_question: How do the already-selected classical and Transformer flagship recipes behave when development, validation, and final evaluation are isolated by original source capture day?
scientific_scope.purpose: Re-evaluate the established IDS2018 flagship flow-feature model recipes under a strictly chronological, capture-day-isolated partition rather than the historical row-level stratified split.
scientific_scope.single_intended_change: Partition/provenance regime. Existing model families, feature family, and model recipes remain inherited/frozen.

title: Stage22 — Temporal / Session-Isolated Flagship Rerun

security_threshold.no_feasible_threshold_policy: Report SECURITY_THRESHOLD_INFEASIBLE. Do not relax the FPR constraint.
